stage1_spec_compliance.summary: Found contract and standards compliance regressions against AGENTS.md + docs/standards hard requirements.

checks.name: Prisma migration flow (AGENTS hard rule)
evidence: Schema diff confirms new enums/models were introduced (+PromptTemplateScene/+PromptTemplateScope/+PromptTemplateStatus/+PromptTemplate/+GlossaryAnchor/+GlossaryTerm)

Scoped tracked migration SQL files contain no prompt_templates/glossary_* DDL matches (apps/backend/prisma/migrations/20260417223016_r2_rag_foundation/migration.sql:1, apps/backend/prisma/migrations/20260417154612_r3_semantic_registry/migration.sql:1)
AGENTS hard rule requires schema change -> generated migration -> prisma:generate (AGENTS.md:129-141)

checks.name: LLM stream/tool contract consistency for prompt template evidence
evidence: Contract requires run.trace.promptTemplate and delivery.evidence.promptTemplate semantic consistency (AGENTS.md:121, docs/standards/llm-stream-tool-migration-spec.md:25-27,49)
Frontend normalizer reconstructs DeliveryEvidenceLayer but omits promptTemplate while normalizing evidence (apps/frontend/src/components/chat/run-visibility-mapper.ts:120-205)
RAG delivery UI consumes delivery.evidence.promptTemplate and renders template status/summary (apps/frontend/src/components/chat/rag-delivery-panel.tsx:108-143,326-335)
Fresh grep check shows promptTemplate references in panel but none in run-visibility mapper parse path

additional_verification.detail: Failed due to missing DATABASE_URL in local environment; command did not execute migration replay.

issues.title: Prompt-template evidence is dropped by frontend normalization, breaking documented sync/stream contract parity
issues.issue: normalizeEvidence rebuilds DeliveryEvidenceLayer from an allowlist of fields and omits promptTemplate, so normalizeDeliveryContract strips promptTemplate from both run and stream payloads.
issues.why_it_matters: Repo standards require prompt-template evidence to be available and semantically consistent across run.trace and delivery.evidence for replay visibility; UI expects it and currently degrades to 'missing'.
issues.fix: Extend normalizeEvidence to parse/preserve promptTemplate (and compat aliases), include it in normalized payload, and add assertions in run-visibility-mapper.spec.ts for prompt-template evidence propagation.

issues.title: Schema introduces new PromptTemplate/Glossary DB objects without corresponding tracked migration SQL in scoped diff
issues.issue: PromptTemplate, GlossaryAnchor, and GlossaryTerm are added in schema, but scoped tracked migration SQL files only contain RAG/Semantic registry DDL and no prompt/glossary table creation.
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS hard rule mandates schema changes be accompanied by Prisma-generated migration SQL and prisma:generate; missing tracked migration artifacts risks migration replay drift and policy non-compliance.
issues.fix: Generate and include Prisma migration(s) for the new schema objects via Prisma CLI (no manual SQL edits) and re-run prisma:generate; then validate with prisma:verify-empty-db in an environment with DATABASE_URL configured.
